grammar.summary: 本课学习 for 表持续时间与现在完成被动（综合巩固）。

points.title: 现在完成进行时
points.explanation: The fire has been burning for three weeks. have been doing 表动作持续至今且可能继续。for + 时间段标志性搭配。

examples.en: The fire has been burning for three weeks.
examples.cn: 大火已经烧了三个星期了。

points.title: 被动与主动配合
points.explanation: The trees were blackened / The hills are now covered with... 描写火灾后果：被动凸显"受灾体"。

examples.en: The whole area is now under threat.
examples.cn: 整个地区现在正受到威胁。
